title: Sandy Irrigation Ditches
description: Sandy Irrigation Ditches in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 63 multilinestring features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: NAME
table:columns.description: Name of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 63 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: SIZE
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 2% of 63 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: HasAttachment
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 63 rows, 2 distinct values, ranging 0 to 1.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: created_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who created the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: created_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was created, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not when the feature was built in the world.

table:columns.name: last_edited_user
table:columns.description: Username of the staff member who last edited the row, from the geodatabase editor tracking.

table:columns.name: last_edited_date
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was last edited, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not a change in the world.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
